Boston is one of the most livable, most innovative cities in the United States. Boston was first incorporated as a town in 1630, and later as a city in 1822. Our Mayor is Michelle Wu and the City is currently home to more than 675,000 residents.

We expect conversations to follow the rules of polite discourse and we ask that participants treat each other, as well as our employees, with respect. Read our full external user agreement at Boston.gov: bit.ly/soctos
